chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 357: The Man – Two Heart-Turbids & Shentu Gang's Secret Method
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang learns the dark truth about the Heart-Turbid's passive horror, gets a whisper of an escape plan, and a forgotten passenger appears in the carriage.
og_title: The Forgotten Heart-Turbid – Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 357
og_description: A man who forgot he was a Heart-Turbid appears in Li Huowang's carriage. Shentu Gang reveals how to control the immortals.
twitter_title: Ch. 357: The Man Who Was Forgotten by His Own Power
twitter_description: A new Heart-Turbid appears out of nowhere, and Shentu Gang drops a game-changing secret about spirit-mediums.

lore_anchors.definition: The corrupted counterpart to the Heart-Element. Its ability is to "hide" or erase concepts, objects, and memories from reality, rather than making fictions real. This effect is often passive and unconscious.
A zone of supernatural influence created by a being's existence, often trapping victims in a cycle of suffering. In this chapter, it refers to the space inside the Heart-Turbid's power.
A formal, rhythmic incantation used by chuma spirit-mediums to summon spirits. It is not a generic folk song; variants can show respect or, as Shentu Gang proves, confrontation.
A high-ranking eunuch official in the Supervisory Heavenly Office; their power is both bureaucratic and supernatural, often wielded through a deceptively genial demeanor.
A high-level cultivation stage where one's spirit coalesces into a second, independent self; Li Huowang casually refers to his own inner-entity as his Nascent Soul.
